Upstream: lzma-rust2 0.21.0, copied from the published crates.io source.
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE. Cargo.toml.orig remains upstream reference.

TRUEOS dependency port:
- Cargo.toml pins the optional SHA-2 dependency to =0.10.9 instead of 0.11,
  with default-features=false to preserve no_std kernel builds (0.10 defaults
  to std, unlike 0.11).
- All upstream compression/decompression/checksum implementation sources remain unchanged.
- The XZ feature still enables SHA-2 and still validates SHA-256 block checksums.
- Tests cover an externally generated SHA-256 XZ stream and a corrupted checksum.

This keeps the decoder fixes from lzma-rust2 0.21 while sharing the kernel's
existing digest 0.10 crypto ecosystem. Do not disable XZ or checksum validation.
